description: Complete trace analysis of vessel-repository-independence specification, including current vs desired state, architectural boundaries, blocking issues, and compliance validation

content.specificationDescription: Each vessel (minibob, metabob-activity-api, activity-dashboard) must be independently deployable with separate git repositories, no cross-vessel imports, and communication only via HTTP/REST APIs. Helm charts must be self-contained within each vessel's repository.
content.expectedBehavior: When developing or deploying any vessel: (1) No import statements reference code from other vessels, (2) All vessel dependencies declared in package.json/requirements.txt, (3) Communication uses HTTP endpoints only (metabob-activity-api provides REST API, dashboard consumes it, minibob executes activities via API), (4) Each vessel has complete Helm chart in its own repo under helm/ directory

traceResults.dataFlow: Dashboard UI → HTTP GET /v2/activities/templates → Auth Middleware (Redis session validation) → Cache Check (Redis) → SurrealDB Query (on cache miss) → Thompson Sampling Filtering → JSON Response → Dashboard State Update | MiniBob MCP Poll → Same Flow → Template Selection → Activity Execution → POST /v2/activities/executions → Thompson Sampling Update (⚠️ RACE CONDITION) → Cache Invalidation

components.currentBehavior: HTTP-only communication with Activity API using fetch, type duplication for schemas
components.desiredBehavior: HTTP-only communication with Activity API using fetch, type duplication for schemas
components.gap: COMPLIANT - No changes needed. Loose coupling achieved.

components.currentBehavior: Exposes REST API endpoints for template listing and execution recording, Thompson Sampling learning loop
components.desiredBehavior: Exposes REST API endpoints for template listing and execution recording, Thompson Sampling learning loop
components.gap: CRITICAL - Race condition in Thompson Sampling (Issue #1). Need atomic UPDATE for metrics.

components.currentBehavior: Redis session validation with Zod, no try-catch for parse failures
components.desiredBehavior: Redis session validation with Zod, graceful error handling with 401 status
components.gap: CRITICAL - Missing try-catch for Zod parse errors (Issue #2). Results in 500 instead of 401.

components.currentBehavior: Hono server with health check endpoint (basic), port 8080
components.desiredBehavior: Hono server with deep health check (Redis + SurrealDB verification), port 8080
components.gap: HIGH - Health check doesn't verify database connectivity (Issue #10). Kubernetes may route to unhealthy pods.

components.currentBehavior: Singleton with auto-reconnect, exponential backoff, cache-aside pattern
components.desiredBehavior: Singleton with auto-reconnect, exponential backoff, cache-aside pattern with distributed locking
components.gap: HIGH - No distributed lock for cache refresh (Issue #3). Cache stampede risk on TTL expiration.

components.currentBehavior: MCP HTTP communication with Activity API for boredom polling
components.desiredBehavior: MCP HTTP communication with Activity API for boredom polling
components.gap: COMPLIANT - No changes needed. HTTP-only communication via MCP.

blockingIssues.description: Thompson Sampling race condition in read-modify-write sequence
blockingIssues.impact: Corrupted metrics under concurrent execution recording
blockingIssues.fix: Replace SELECT + UPDATE with single atomic UPDATE using SurrealDB += operator
blockingIssues.code: UPDATE variant_performance_metrics SET total_executions += 1, successful_executions += $success_delta, failed_executions += $failure_delta, thompson_alpha = successful_executions + 1, thompson_beta = failed_executions + 1, success_rate = successful_executions / total_executions WHERE variant_id = $variant_id

blockingIssues.description: Missing try-catch for Zod parse failures
blockingIssues.impact: Returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of 401 Unauthorized on corrupted session data
blockingIssues.fix: Wrap SessionDataSchema.parse() in try-catch with proper HTTP status codes
blockingIssues.code: try { const sessionData = SessionDataSchema.parse(JSON.parse(sessionDataRaw)); } catch (error) { if (error instanceof z.ZodError) { logger.warn('Invalid session schema', { error: error.errors }); } return c.json({ error: 'Invalid session' }, 401); }

highPriorityIssues.description: Cache stampede risk on TTL expiration
highPriorityIssues.impact: SurrealDB overload when N clients simultaneously query on cache miss
highPriorityIssues.fix: Implement distributed lock using Redis SETNX for cache refresh operations

highPriorityIssues.description: Health check endpoint doesn't verify database connectivity
highPriorityIssues.impact: Kubernetes routes traffic to pods with Redis/SurrealDB connection failures
highPriorityIssues.fix: Add Redis PING and SurrealDB query to /health endpoint with 503 status on failure

architecturalBoundaries.coupling: LOOSE - Type duplication, no shared code

architecturalBoundaries.resilience: ⚠️ No retry strategy (throws on connection error)
